notes.title: Patch-notes Early Access version 1.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34598082/ef6b724b295600eb81d4fe1ae1cefbe266a81990.png[/img]

[h3]New Features[/h3]

[list]
[*][b]Portuguese and Spanish languages added![/b]
[/list]
Adding to English, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Russian versions, Minimal Move is now playable in Portuguese and Spanish!

You can now change the language directly in the game.

[list]
[*][b]More puzzles to play![/b]
[/list]
We added 12 new levels! Woo-hoo!

[list]
[*][b]New cinematics and story added! [/b]
[/list]
Let’s discover the story of Minimal Move with fun cinematics! 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34598082/c80132366d90a384f299804b39e6b70b64ca8087.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34598082/d6f9554c8fa411c55501a025d7033c6e64fb5fe2.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*][b]Skin customization system for the characters added! [/b]
[/list]
Enjoy choosing your favorite skins for the characters! Now you can unlock the skins by using the stars that you collected in the levels! 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34598082/636bf9f958c529eb4263ed87d827aff643037611.jpg[/img]


[h3]Fixed Bug[/h3]

[list]
[*] We fixed un issue with the sound. 
[/list]

[list]
[*] Minor fix on the HUD. 
[/list]

notes.title: Minimal Move Early Access is available on Steam today!
notes.content:
[h1]Today is the day![/h1]  
[h1]Minimal Move launches into early access on Steam starting from today![/h1]


[previewyoutube=h7cPIibnmpA;full][/previewyoutube]


The current Early Access version will offer the first 3 worlds with the core gameplay mechanic. 

And the most exciting part is the online coop mode! You can now play the puzzle with your friends online on Steam by using the Remote Play Together feature! 


It's difficult time now to see your family and friends if you live separately, but not on Minimal Move anymore!

Please try this online coop mode! Stay home and stay safe but enjoy the time!

Don't hesitate to invite your family and friends to Minimal Move! Let's play together!


New contents will be added during the early access such as cinematics, skin system, and new puzzles.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34598082/30f7151a8128194c92751a4fdc19a46467680620.jpg[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34598082/ea6dd22d3190b2639506edd8d335752ae52a3068.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34598082/11fe7ea51db43ee23c9fabbe3863685b0d86c096.jpg[/img]


We are so excited about this release and we are curious what people say about this game.


The production is still continuing.


Before you buy this early access version (if you are willing to do so... we hope!) , we have to mention that this is an early access version which means it's not finished yet completely.



We did this early access for making better game with people's feedback.



We need to know your opinion, both good and bad.



Please give us your feedback by our Steam community hub, on our Discord, DM us by Twitter, Instagram, and Facebook, or simply email us!


We hope you enjoy it! Thank you!

notes.title: Introducing Lunar World!
notes.content:
[h1]Lunar World... A blue dimly lit world in the moonlight...[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/e2afca6e39de76fbc8c378b103fa428483e824ba.png[/img]

Let's introduce Minimal Move's third world, Lunar world!

It sounds pretty and romantic but it’s getting harder and harder!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/3c7188372fd1c5805eae7c890d8e2fa388d5f606.jpg[/img]

There is a fun cube to play with in this world which is called a Jumper cube!

The jumper cube can transfer Kaiten and Ido to the other jumber cube!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/886ff3ef253d616683fc97c4c5f84277acbdb4a4.jpg[/img]

A new robot in this world, Beaman is heating up blocks by his beam. He will stop you leaving from this world in silence... And yes, the beam can kill KAITEN and IDO... Watch out!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/8a5c6f23f59ad56c5194fe2a60e8eba73573cb6c.jpg[/img]

How to get out from this world!?? More and more challenging!!!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/346c9493b794b7cfd59f63e46f6bf73874b54b4b.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Introducing Lava World!
notes.content:
[h1]Lava World! It's hot in here![/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/0b6b8680cacb13e18da6de82e437344b7b5f141e.png[/img]

Let's introduce Minimal Move's second world, Lava World!

Lava world is much more tricky than Oasis World!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/ee8f9e1b5fd7a0274bce5534f8e6b57a4ed5786f.jpg[/img]

Lava world is like it says, a hot world!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/886ff3ef253d616683fc97c4c5f84277acbdb4a4.jpg[/img]

The blocks are dangerous! They can burn them up!

You can move blocks using a Lava block. Watch your steps and use the heat to move blocks!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/2959b10e88a6b231d984132bc6baa32deddc7c0b.jpg[/img]

There is a new character Flammeche as a guard of this world.

He is cute, but he can make a block to a lava block so be careful!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/b073b8336201695ff519d948d90e34c4fcb23537.png[/img]

notes.title: Introducing Oasis World!
notes.content:
[h1]Oasis World! What is that?[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/f70f4a3962fc340a2662e6c129045fd2368a6479.png[/img]

Let’s introduce Minimal Move's first world, Oasis World!

This will be the first world that you'll go.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/efb65e7908c5c533639c9c0eabd5dd2f3a43cd9f.jpg[/img]

It’s an introductory world so let’s say it’s pretty much safe.

There are some cactus that block your way.

You'll get used to how to use the controllers, the mechanics of this game, and the most importantly you'll get to know how to think in 3D!

We are so used to see things in 2D on the game, so first you might get confused to think in 3D because the blocks will turn all the way around!



Oasis World is pretty safe but it's a good exercise of your brain!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/45077fa50ea3e5a001687f9c1380f3ccb70543e6.jpg[/img]

In the beginning, you might think it’s difficult, but it’s actually getting simple later!

Next world will be much more dangerous! Be prepared for that!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/2e688459d7d5c1e5141ce1b49b4a6c2df4c03d14.jpg[/img]
